AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @isAdmin	VARCHAR(3),@ID			INT;

(
	@childID INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @encryptionKey VARCHAR(50) = '[SQL literal withheld]';

	DECLARE @encyptedTEXT VARCHAR(100);
		
	--SELECT @encyptedKey = EncryptByPassPhrase(@encryptionKey, CONCAT(child_id,'_',Parent.parent_id,'_',center_id))
	SELECT @encyptedTEXT = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(32),HashBytes('MD5', CONCAT(child_id,'_',Parent.parent_id,'_',center_id)),2)
	FROM Child INNER JOIN Parent ON Parent.parent_id = child.parent_id 
	WHERE child_id = @childID AND ISNULL(child.deleted,0) <> 1 AND ISNULL(parent.deleted,0) <> 1

	
-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @encyptedTEXT
	--RETURN CONVERT(VARCHAR(MAX),@encyptedKey,2)

name: getMonthYearLastDate
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-7-2017
-- Description:	Get the last date from an input of month & year
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[getMonthYearLastDate]
(
	 @month INT
	,@year  INT

)
RETURNS DATE

AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE;
	DECLARE @currentDate	DATE = GETDATE();

	IF @month <> -1 AND @year <> -1
		BEGIN
			SET @requestedDate =  EOMONTH (CAST( CAST(@month AS VARCHAR) + '[SQL literal withheld]'  + CAST(@year AS VARCHAR) AS DATE));
			IF @requestedDate > @currentDate
				SET @requestedDate =  @currentDate;
		END
	ELSE
		SET @requestedDate =  @currentDate;
	

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @requestedDate
	
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-23-2019
-- Description:	Add Care center
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_addCareCenter]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@name				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@email				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@landline			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@mobile			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@website			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@domain			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@logo				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@photo				NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@description		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@address			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@location			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@manager			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@type				INT
	,@currency			INT

	-- User Data
	,@userName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@password			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@firstName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@lastName			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@userEmail			NVARCHAR(MAX) 


	,@centerID			INT = -1 OUTPUT
	,@updateStatus		INT = -1 OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY 

		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		-- Add the center info
		INSERT INTO dbo.Care_Center (center_name,center_description,center_address,center_location,center_mobile
								,center_land_line,center_email,center_website,center_logo,center_photo,center_manager,type,center_currency) 
	    VALUES (@name,@description,@address,@location,@mobile,@landline,@email,@website,@logo,@photo,@manager,@type,@currency)
	
		SELECT @centerID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
		
		-- Add the notification icons data
		INSERT INTO dbo.[Status](status_logo,center_id,status_description, status_order, deleted)
			SELECT        status_logo,@centerID,status_description,status_order, deleted
			FROM          [dbo].[Status]
			WHERE        (center_id = -1) AND ISNULL(deleted,0) <> 1

		-- SET by default the new center input type as QR Code
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Center_Child_Input_Type] (center_id,input_type_id) VALUES (@centerID,3)
		
		-- Add center Variables
		EXEC icare_secure.dbo.iCareAdmin_addCenterVariables @dealerID,@centerID,@type,@domain

		-- Add center user
		DECLARE @userStatus INT
		EXEC dbo.[iCareAdmin_addCenterUser] @centerID,@userName,@password,@firstName,@lastName,@userEmail,@userStatus OUTPUT

		If @userStatus = 1
			BEGIN
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
				SELECT @updateStatus = 1
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
				SELECT @updateStatus = -1
			END
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;


		SELECT @updateStatus = -1
	END CATCH;
	
END

name: iCareAdmin_addCenterUser
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 7-4-2019
-- Description:	Create a default admin user for center
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_addCenterUser]
	
		 @centerID		INT  
		,@userName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@password		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@firstName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@lastName		NVARCHAR(MAX)
		,@email			NVARCHAR(MAX) 
		,@updateStatus  INT = 0 OUTPUT

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY 

		BEGIN TRANSACTION

		--Create the user
	    INSERT INTO sec_users (Username,Password,Firstname,Lastname,Email,classes_full_access,center_id)
		VALUES (@userName,@password,@firstName,@lastName,@email,1,@centerID)
	
		DECLARE @userID INT
		SELECT @userID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
	
		-- Link user to center
		INSERT INTO secCareCenterUser (center_id,UserID)
		VALUES (@centerID,@userID)
	
		--Create a default admin role   
		INSERT INTO dbo.Sec_Roles(Name,Description,center_id) 
		VALUES ('[SQL literal withheld]','[SQL literal withheld]',@centerID)
	
		DECLARE @roleID INT 
		SELECT @roleID = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
	
		-- Link the user to his new created role
		INSERT INTO dbo.Sec_UserRoles(UserID,RoleID) VALUES(@userID,@roleID)
	            
		DECLARE @centerType INT ;
		SELECT  @centerType = type FROM dbo.Care_Center WHERE center_id = @centerID
	
		-- Add the default pages to the old table [This needs to be removed over time]
		INSERT INTO dbo.System_Role_Menu(menuid,roleid)
		SELECT menuID,@roleID FROM dbo.System_Menus WHERE centertype = @centerType
	
		-- Add the default pages for the requested center type and link to the newly created role
		INSERT INTO dbo.System_Role_Menu_Web(menuid,roleid) 
		SELECT menuID,@roleID FROM dbo.System_Menus_New WHERE centertype = @centerType
	
		EXEC icare_secure.dbo.addNewCenterUser   @userID,@userName,@centerID,@centerType,@password,1
	
		COMMIT TRANSACTION

		SELECT @updateStatus = 1
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
	    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

		SELECT @updateStatus = -1
	END CATCH;

END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get Center class children list
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterClassChildren]
	
	 @centerID			INT
	,@classID			INT
	,@requestMonth		INT = -1
	,@requestYear		INT = -1
	,@requestAll		BIT  = 1 -- A boolean flag to check if the request needs to retrieve the deleted children as well 

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE = dbo.getMonthYearLastDate(@requestMonth,@requestYear);

	SELECT children.child_id,is_Demo,child_name 
	FROM [dbo].[Child]  children
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[Class_Child]	classChildren	ON classChildren.Child_ID = children.child_id
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[Parent]		parents			ON parents.parent_id		= children.parent_id
		INNER JOIN [dbo].[Class]		classes			ON classChildren.Class_ID = classes.class_id
	WHERE (classChildren.Class_ID= @classID   OR @classID = -1)
		AND classes.center_id = @centerID
		AND (ISNULL(children.deleted,0)			<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1)
		AND (ISNULL(parents.deleted,0)			<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1) 
		AND (ISNULL(classes.deleted,0)			<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1) 
		AND CONVERT(DATE,children.creation_date)	<= @requestedDate 
		
END

name: iCareAdmin_getCenterClassesData
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get Center classes info with student counts
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getCenterClassesData]
	
	 @centerID			INT
	,@requestMonth		INT = -1
	,@requestYear		INT = -1
	,@requestAll		BIT  = 1 -- A boolean flag to check if the request needs to retrieve the deleted children as well 

AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE = dbo.getMonthYearLastDate(@requestMonth,@requestYear);


	SELECT  centers.center_name, classes.class_name,
			 COUNT(classChildren.Child_ID) AS Student, ISNULL(classes.class_logo,'') class_logo, classes.center_id, classes.class_id
	FROM     [dbo].[Class_Child] classChildren
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[Class]		classes	 ON classChildren.Class_ID = classes.class_id 
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[Care_Center]	centers	 ON classes.center_id			= centers.center_id 
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[Child]		children ON classChildren.Child_ID = children.child_id 
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[Parent]		parents	 ON parents.parent_id			= children.parent_id 
	WHERE centers.center_id = @centerID 
		AND (ISNULL(children.deleted,0)	<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1)
		AND (ISNULL(classes.deleted,0)	<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1)
		AND (ISNULL(parents.deleted,0)	<> 1  OR @requestAll = 1)
		AND CONVERT(DATE,children.creation_date)	<= @requestedDate 
	GROUP BY classes.class_name, classes.class_logo, centers.center_name, classes.center_id, classes.class_id 
	ORDER BY centers.center_name, classes.class_name 

END

name: iCareAdmin_getChildActiveDays
iCareAdmin_getChildLatestActivationTransactions
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-2-2017
-- Description:	Get child latest activation transactions including addition, activation and deactivation 
--				inorder to conclude the number of active days per month used for billing
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getChildLatestActivationTransactions]
	 
	  @childID			INT
	 ,@requestMonth		INT = -1
	 ,@requestYear		INT = -1


AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	DECLARE @requestedDate	DATE = dbo.getMonthYearLastDate(@requestMonth,@requestYear);
		
	SELECT child_id
		,CASE WHEN transaction_code = 6 THEN 
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(child_is_active_on_restore,1) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END 
			ELSE transaction_code END AS transaction_code -- UPDATE In order to deal with the restore transactions set the code based on the activity status on the restore time
	, transaction_date,CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),transaction_date,101) as trans_date,
		'[SQL literal withheld]' AS this_month 
		FROM [dbo].[Child_Transactions] WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE	DATEPART(m, transaction_date) = DATEPART(m, @requestedDate) 
			AND DATEPART(yyyy, transaction_date) = DATEPART(yyyy, @requestedDate) AND child_id = @childID 
			AND (transaction_code =1 OR transaction_code =2 OR transaction_code =3 OR transaction_code =5 OR transaction_code =6)
	UNION
		SELECT child_id
		,CASE WHEN transaction_code = 6 THEN 
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(child_is_active_on_restore,1) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END 
			ELSE transaction_code END AS transaction_code -- UPDATE In order to deal with the restore transactions set the code based on the activity status on the restore time
		, transaction_date,CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),transaction_date,101) AS trans_date,
		'[SQL literal withheld]' AS this_month 
		FROM (
				SELECT child_id,transaction_code,child_is_active_on_restore, transaction_date,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY transaction_date DESC) '[SQL literal withheld]'
				FROM [dbo].[Child_Transactions] WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE CONVERT(DATE,transaction_date) <= DATEADD(d, -DATEPART(d,@requestedDate), @requestedDate) AND child_id = @childID
					AND (transaction_code =1 OR transaction_code =2 OR transaction_code =3 OR transaction_code =5 OR transaction_code =6)
			) AS Tab
		WHERE rowRank = 1
	ORDER BY transaction_date

END

name: iCareAdmin_getUserAccountingCentersList
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 12-2-2019
-- Description:	Get the list of dealer centers along with their last downloaded invoice 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_getUserAccountingCentersList]
	 @userID		INT -- The user id requesting the data
	,@filterUserID  INT = -1
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @getAll BIT 

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT 
	SELECT @isAdmin = is_super_admin FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealers] WHERE dealer_id = @userID

	
	IF @isAdmin = 1 
		BEGIN
			SELECT centers.center_id,centers.center_type,center_name,centers.dealer_id admin_user_id,centers.dealer_name admin_user_name,centers.is_active,download_time
			FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[vwDealerCenters] centers  
				--LEFT JOIN  [icare_secure].[dbo].Center_Status centerStatus ON centers.center_id = centerStatus.center_id AND centers.center_type = centerStatus.center_type
				LEFT JOIN 
				( SELECT  center_id,admin_user_id,download_time, ROW_NUMBER()
	                OVER (PARTITION BY center_id,admin_user_id ORDER BY download_time DESC) AS RowNum
					FROM    [dbo].[Center_Invoicing]
				) invoicing ON invoicing.center_id = centers.center_id AND RowNum = 1 AND invoicing.admin_user_id = @userID
			WHERE centers.center_type <> 4 AND (centers.dealer_id = @filterUserID OR @filterUserID = -1)
				--AND ISNULL(centerStatus.activation_status,1) <> 0
			ORDER BY center_name
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			
			DECLARE @pageID INT = 7

			SELECT centers.center_id,center_type,center_name,centers.dealer_id admin_user_id,centers.dealer_name admin_user_name,centers.is_active,download_time
			FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[vwDealerCenters] centers  
				LEFT JOIN 
				( SELECT  center_id,admin_user_id,download_time, ROW_NUMBER()
	                OVER (PARTITION BY center_id,admin_user_id ORDER BY download_time DESC) AS RowNum
					FROM    [dbo].[Center_Invoicing]
				) invoicing ON invoicing.center_id = centers.center_id AND RowNum = 1 AND invoicing.admin_user_id = @userID
			WHERE centers.dealer_id = @userID AND centers.center_type <> 4 
			UNION
			-- Get the list of centers the selected dealer has special access to and are not under his account
			SELECT centers.center_id,centers.center_type,center_name,centers.dealer_id admin_user_id,'[SQL literal withheld]' admin_user_name,centers.is_active,download_time
			FROM [icare_secure].[dbo].[vwDealerCenters] centers  
				INNER JOIN [icare_secure].[dbo].[Dealer_Page_Center_Access] pageAccess 
						ON pageAccess.center_id = centers.center_id		  AND pageAccess.center_type = centers.[center_type]
																		  AND pageAccess.page_id	 = @pageID 
																		  AND pageAccess.dealer_id	 = @userID
				LEFT JOIN 
				( SELECT  center_id,admin_user_id,download_time, ROW_NUMBER()
	                OVER (PARTITION BY center_id,admin_user_id ORDER BY download_time DESC) AS RowNum
					FROM    [dbo].[Center_Invoicing]
				) invoicing ON invoicing.center_id = centers.center_id AND RowNum = 1 AND invoicing.admin_user_id = @userID
			WHERE centers.dealer_id <> @userID AND centers.center_type <> 4 
			ORDER BY center_name
		END

END

name: iCareAdmin_resetCenterAlertMessage
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 2-26-2021
-- Description:	Reset selected centers alert messages
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_resetCenterAlertMessage]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@centersList		dbo.Element_ID_List READONLY
	,@updateStatus		INT  = 0 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT = [icare_secure].[dbo].[isDealerSuperAdmin](@DealerID)
		IF @isAdmin = 1 
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY 

					BEGIN TRANSACTION
					
					DECLARE @centersTable TABLE (center_id INT, center_type INT)
						INSERT INTO @centersTable
						SELECT center_id,[type] 
						FROM [dbo].[Care_Center] centers INNER JOIN @centersList  centersList ON centersList.ID = centers.center_id

					DELETE FROM [dbo].[Center_Alert_Message] 
					WHERE center_id IN (SELECT center_id FROM @centersTable)


					DECLARE @centerID INT,@centerType INT; -- used as an index for looping
					WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @centersTable) > 0
						BEGIN  
							SELECT TOP(1) @centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type FROM @centersTable 
							EXEC [icare_log].[dbo].[record_centerAlertMessageUpdates]  @centerID,@centerType,@dealerID,'[SQL literal withheld]'
							DELETE FROM @centersTable WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type  = @centerType
						END  

					COMMIT TRANSACTION;
					SELECT @updateStatus = 1
				END TRY 

				BEGIN CATCH
					IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

					SELECT @updateStatus = -1
				END CATCH;
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @updateStatus = 0
			END
	
	    
END

name: iCareAdmin_updateCenterAlertMessage
definition:
-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 4-10-2018
-- Description:	set/modify the center alert messages
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterAlertMessage]
	
	 @dealerID			INT
	,@messageText		NVARCHAR(250)
	,@messageExpiryDate	DATE
	,@centersList		dbo.Element_ID_List READONLY
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @isAdmin BIT = [icare_secure].[dbo].[isDealerSuperAdmin](@DealerID)

	BEGIN TRY 
		BEGIN TRANSACTION
		
		DECLARE @currentDate DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()
		DECLARE @centersTable TABLE (center_id INT, center_type INT)
		INSERT INTO @centersTable
			SELECT center_id,[type] 
			FROM [dbo].[Care_Center] centers INNER JOIN @centersList  centersList ON centersList.ID = centers.center_id

		UPDATE  alerts
		SET alerts.dealer_id = @dealerID, alerts.message_text = @messageText,alerts.alert_expiry_date = @messageExpiryDate,alerts.update_time = @currentDate
		FROM [dbo].Center_Alert_Message alerts INNER JOIN @centersTable centers ON alerts.center_id = centers.center_id

	    -- Add columns that has no data
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[Center_Alert_Message](center_id,message_text,alert_expiry_date,dealer_id,update_time)
			SELECT centers.center_id,@messageText,@messageExpiryDate,@dealerID,@currentDate
			FROM @centersTable centers LEFT JOIN [dbo].Center_Alert_Message alerts ON alerts.center_id = centers.center_id
			WHERE alerts.center_id  IS NULL

		--== Logging
		DECLARE @centerID INT,@centerType INT; -- used as an index for looping
		WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @centersTable) > 0
			BEGIN  
				SELECT TOP(1) @centerID = center_id,@centerType = center_type FROM @centersTable 
				EXEC [icare_log].[dbo].[record_centerAlertMessageUpdates]  @centerID,@centerType,@dealerID,'[SQL literal withheld]',@messageText,@messageExpiryDate
				DELETE FROM @centersTable WHERE center_id = @centerID AND center_type  = @centerType
			END  


		COMMIT TRANSACTION;
		RETURN  1
	END TRY 

	BEGIN CATCH
		IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
		RETURN -1
	END CATCH;

END

name: iCareAdmin_updateCenterCowPayApiSettings

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 8-30-2021
-- Description:	Update the center cowpay Api setting
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterCowPayApiSettings]
	
	 @centerID				INT
	,@centerType			INT
	,@merchantCode			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@merchantHashKey		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@accessToken			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@stagingAccessToken	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@isEnabled				BIT
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @updateTime DATETIME = GETUTCDATE()

	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] WHERE center_id = @centerID)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO  [dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] (center_id,center_type,merchant_code,merchant_hash_key,access_token,staging_access_token,is_enabled,creation_date,update_time)
			VALUES (@centerID,@centerType,@merchantCode,@merchantHashKey,@accessToken,@stagingAccessToken,@isEnabled,@updateTime,@updateTime)
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE [dbo].[Cowpay_Center_Api_Settings] 
			SET merchant_code		= @merchantCode
			,merchant_hash_key		= @merchantHashKey
			,access_token			= @accessToken
			,staging_access_token	= @stagingAccessToken
			,is_enabled				= @isEnabled
			,update_time			= @updateTime
			WHERE center_id = @centerID
		END

		RETURN 1;



END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Monir
-- Create date: 9-24-2019
-- Description:	Update care center info
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterInfo]
	 @dealerID		INT
	,@centerID		INT
	,@name			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@email			NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@landline		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@mobile		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@website		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@description	NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@address		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@manager		NVARCHAR(MAX)
	,@inputType		INT
	,@updateStatus	INT = -1 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	BEGIN TRY
		UPDATE dbo.Care_Center SET  
			 center_name			= @name
			,center_description		= @description
			,center_address			= @address
			,center_mobile			= @mobile
			,center_land_line		= @landline
			,center_email			= @email
			,center_website			= @website
			,center_manager			= @manager
		WHERE center_id = @centerID

		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Center_Child_Input_Type WHERE center_id = @centerID)
			BEGIN 
				UPDATE Center_Child_Input_Type SET input_type_id = @inputType WHERE center_id = @centerID
            END
		ELSE
			BEGIN 
				INSERT INTO Center_Child_Input_Type (center_id,input_type_id) VALUES (@centerID,@inputType)
			END
		

		SELECT @updateStatus = 1

	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH  
		 SELECT @updateStatus = 0
	END CATCH; 
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[iCareAdmin_updateCenterUserInfo]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here

	,@firstName		NVARCHAR(100)
	,@lastName		NVARCHAR(100)
	,@email			NVARCHAR(100)
	,@password		NVARCHAR(450)
	,@updateStatus	INT = -1 OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	BEGIN TRY  
		
		UPDATE dbo.sec_users  SET Firstname = @firstName
					,Lastname	= @lastName
					,Email		= @email
					,[Password]	= @password
		WHERE ID = @userID 

		DECLARE @username NVARCHAR(450)
		SELECT @username = Username FROM dbo.sec_users WHERE ID = @userID
	
		EXECUTE [icare_secure].[dbo].[updateUserPassword]  @userName,'',@password,1,1

		SELECT @updateStatus = 1
	END TRY  
	BEGIN CATCH  
		 SELECT @updateStatus = 0
	END CATCH 

    
END

name: spGenerateChildQrCode
definition:
CREATE proc [dbo].[spGenerateChildQrCode]
 @child_id AS INT,
 @qrcode as NVARCHAR(MAX) output
as 

DECLARE @id INT; 
DECLARE @input_type INT = 3; 

SELECT @qrcode = dbo.[Getencyrptedqrcodevalue](@child_id) 

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * 
               FROM   child_inputs 
                      INNER JOIN qr_code 
                              ON child_inputs.input_id = qr_code.qr_code_id 
                                 AND child_inputs.input_type = @input_type 
               WHERE  child_id = @child_id) 
  BEGIN 
      INSERT INTO qr_code 
                  (qr_value) 
      SELECT @qrcode  

      SELECT @id = Scope_identity(); 

      INSERT INTO child_inputs 
                  (child_id, 
                   input_id, 
                   input_type) 
      SELECT @child_id, 
             @id, 
             @input_type 
  END

name: TR_Care_Center_Time_Zone_History
definition:
CREATE   TRIGGER dbo.TR_Care_Center_Time_Zone_History
ON dbo.Care_Center
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @capturedAtUtc DATETIME2(3) = SYSUTCDATETIME();
    DECLARE @changes TABLE
    (
        center_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        time_zone NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
        changed_at_utc DATETIME2(3) NOT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @changes (center_id, time_zone, changed_at_utc)
    SELECT inserted.center_id,
           inserted.time_zone,
           CASE
             WHEN current_interval.valid_from_utc >= @capturedAtUtc
               THEN DATEADD(MILLISECOND, 1, current_interval.valid_from_utc)
             ELSE @capturedAtUtc
           END
      FROM inserted
      LEFT JOIN deleted ON deleted.center_id = inserted.center_id
      OUTER APPLY
      (
          SELECT TOP (1) history.valid_from_utc
            FROM dbo.Care_Center_Time_Zone_History history
           WHERE history.center_id = inserted.center_id
             AND history.valid_to_utc IS NULL
           ORDER BY history.valid_from_utc DESC
      ) current_interval
     WHERE deleted.center_id IS NULL OR inserted.time_zone <> deleted.time_zone;

    UPDATE history
       SET valid_to_utc = changes.changed_at_utc
      FROM dbo.Care_Center_Time_Zone_History history
      JOIN @changes changes ON changes.center_id = history.center_id
     WHERE history.valid_to_utc IS NULL;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Care_Center_Time_Zone_History
        (center_id, time_zone, valid_from_utc, valid_to_utc)
    SELECT center_id, time_zone, changed_at_utc, NULL
      FROM @changes;
END;

name: trg_SystemMenusNew_SyncToNursery

CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_SystemMenusNew_SyncToNursery]
ON [dbo].[System_Menus_New]
AFTER INSERT, UPDATE
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    UPDATE nmp
    SET nmp.[active]    = i.[active],
        nmp.[visible]   = i.[Visible],
        nmp.[pageName]  = i.[page_name],
        nmp.[updatedAt] = GETDATE()
    FROM [dbo].[Nursery_Menu_Pages] nmp
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[Nursery_Menu_Page_Legacy_Links] lnk
        ON lnk.[nurseryMenuId] = nmp.[id]
    INNER JOIN inserted i
        ON i.[state] = lnk.[legacyState]
       AND i.[CenterType] = lnk.[legacyCenterType];
END

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vwChildClassParent] AS

SELECT
    children.child_id,
    children.parent_id,
    children.child_dob,
    children.child_photo,
    ISNULL(children.is_active, 1)  AS is_active,
    children.subscription_end,
    children.gender,
    children.child_name,
    children.special_needs,
    children.child_pin,
    children.registration_date,
    children.is_demo,
    children.activation_date,
    children.can_takephoto,
    children.child_notes,
    classes.class_id,
    CASE
        WHEN classes.center_id IS NULL THEN parents.center_id
        ELSE classes.center_id
    END                            AS center_id,
    classes.class_theme,
    classes.class_logo,
    classes.class_section,
    classes.class_name,
    classes.class_description,
    classes.class_category,
    parents.primary_mobile,
    parents.primary_landline,
    parents.emergency_mobile,
    parents.emergency_landline,
    parents.parent_name,
    parents.spouse_name,
    parents.primary_contact,
    parents.emergency_contact,
    parents.primary_address,
    parents.email
FROM   dbo.Child       children
       INNER JOIN dbo.Class_Child classChild ON classChild.child_id  = children.child_id
       INNER JOIN dbo.Class       classes    ON classChild.class_id  = classes.class_id
       INNER JOIN dbo.Parent      parents    ON parents.parent_id    = children.parent_id
WHERE  ISNULL(children.deleted, 0) = 0
  AND  ISNULL(parents.deleted, 0) = 0
  AND  ISNULL(classes.deleted, 0) = 0;
